properties.title: Transaction signature R component must be in valid range before sender recovery
properties.description: For any transaction submitted via JSON-RPC (EDGE-TX-SUBMIT-RPC), the ECDSA signature R component must satisfy 0 < r < SECP256K1N. Transactions with R outside this range must be rejected before any state modification occurs.
properties.formal_spec: PRE: tx.r > 0 AND tx.r < SECP256K1N => sender_recovery_proceeds; tx.r == 0 OR tx.r >= SECP256K1N => reject(tx)
properties.rationale: Boundary edge EDGE-TX-SUBMIT-RPC requires full signature validation. Invalid R values could cause undefined behavior in secp256k1_recover.

properties.title: Transaction signature S component must satisfy low-s requirement
properties.description: For any submitted transaction, the ECDSA signature S component must satisfy 0 < s <= SECP256K1N / 2 (BIP-62 malleability fix). This prevents signature malleability attacks at the boundary.
properties.formal_spec: PRE: tx.s > 0 AND tx.s <= SECP256K1N / 2 => proceed; ELSE => reject(tx)
properties.rationale: Without low-s enforcement, attackers could create alternative valid signatures for the same transaction, breaking transaction uniqueness.

properties.title: Transaction type byte must map to supported transaction type
properties.description: When raw transaction bytes arrive at EDGE-TX-SUBMIT-RPC, the first byte determines the type: >= 0xc0 for legacy, 0x01 for access list, 0x02 for fee market, 0x03 for blob, 0x04 for set-code. Any other first byte must cause rejection.
properties.formal_spec: PRE: tx_bytes[0] IN {0x01, 0x02, 0x03, 0x04} OR tx_bytes[0] >= 0xc0 => decode_proceeds; ELSE => reject(tx_bytes)
properties.rationale: Unsupported transaction types at the RPC boundary must be rejected to prevent processing of malformed data.

properties.title: Transaction gas must exceed both intrinsic cost and EIP-7623 floor cost
properties.description: For any transaction crossing EDGE-TX-SUBMIT-RPC, tx.gas must satisfy tx.gas >= max(intrinsic_cost, floor_cost) where intrinsic_cost = 21000 + calldata_cost + create_cost + access_list_cost + auth_cost, and floor_cost = total_tokens * FLOOR_CALLDATA_COST + 21000.
properties.formal_spec: PRE: tx.gas >= max(calculate_intrinsic_cost(tx), calculate_floor_cost(tx)) => validate_proceeds; ELSE => reject(tx)
properties.rationale: EIP-7623 introduces a calldata floor cost to prevent underpriced calldata-heavy transactions. Both costs must be satisfied.

properties.title: Transaction nonce must not overflow 2^64 - 1
properties.description: Any transaction at EDGE-TX-SUBMIT-RPC must have nonce < 2^64 - 1 per EIP-2681. This prevents nonce overflow attacks.
properties.formal_spec: PRE: tx.nonce < 2^64 - 1 => proceed; tx.nonce >= 2^64 - 1 => reject(tx)
properties.rationale: Nonce overflow would wrap around, potentially allowing replay of old transactions or state corruption.

properties.title: Contract creation init code must not exceed MAX_INIT_CODE_SIZE
properties.description: For contract creation transactions (to == None) arriving at EDGE-TX-SUBMIT-RPC, init code size must be <= MAX_INIT_CODE_SIZE (EIP-3860). Oversized init code must be rejected.
properties.formal_spec: PRE: tx.to == None AND len(tx.data) > MAX_INIT_CODE_SIZE => reject(tx); ELSE => proceed
properties.rationale: Unbounded init code could be used for DoS attacks through excessive computation during contract creation.

properties.title: EIP-1559 fee cap relationship must hold: max_fee >= max_priority_fee >= 0
properties.description: For EIP-1559+ transactions at EDGE-TX-SUBMIT-RPC, max_fee_per_gas must be >= max_priority_fee_per_gas, and max_fee_per_gas must be >= base_fee_per_gas of the current block.
properties.formal_spec: PRE: tx.max_fee_per_gas >= tx.max_priority_fee_per_gas AND tx.max_fee_per_gas >= block.base_fee_per_gas => proceed; ELSE => reject(tx)
properties.rationale: Violating fee cap constraints would break the EIP-1559 fee market mechanism or allow negative priority fees.

properties.title: Sender must have sufficient balance for gas fees plus value transfer
properties.description: For any transaction at EDGE-TX-SUBMIT-RPC, sender balance must cover gas * max_fee_per_gas + value + blob_gas_fee (if applicable).
properties.formal_spec: PRE: sender.balance >= tx.gas * tx.max_fee_per_gas + tx.value + blob_data_fee(tx) => proceed; ELSE => reject(tx)
properties.rationale: Insufficient balance would leave the system unable to collect gas fees, creating an imbalance.

properties.title: Blob transaction versioned hashes must use KZG version byte 0x01
properties.description: For blob transactions at EDGE-BLOB-TX-SUBMIT, all versioned hashes must have first byte == 0x01 (KZG version), and the blob hash list must be non-empty.
properties.formal_spec: PRE: for all vh in tx.blob_versioned_hashes: vh[0] == 0x01; AND len(tx.blob_versioned_hashes) > 0 => proceed; ELSE => reject(tx)
properties.rationale: Invalid version bytes indicate malformed or unsupported blob commitments. Empty blob lists waste resources.

properties.title: Blob gas must not exceed MAX_BLOB_GAS_PER_BLOCK
properties.description: For blob transactions at EDGE-BLOB-TX-SUBMIT, cumulative blob gas consumed must not exceed MAX_BLOB_GAS_PER_BLOCK (1,179,648).
properties.formal_spec: PRE: cumulative_blob_gas + tx_blob_gas <= MAX_BLOB_GAS_PER_BLOCK => proceed; ELSE => reject(tx)
properties.rationale: Exceeding blob gas limits would allow unbounded data availability consumption.

properties.title: Block header must pass all validation checks before body execution
properties.description: For blocks received at EDGE-BLOCK-PRODUCER-P2P, header validation must verify: sequential block number, increasing timestamp, gas limit within bounds, correct base fee, zero difficulty, zero nonce, empty ommers hash, valid parent hash.
properties.formal_spec: PRE: validate_header(block.header, parent_header) == true => apply_body(block); ELSE => reject(block)
properties.rationale: Header validation is the first defense against invalid blocks from untrusted block producers.

properties.title: Computed state root must match block header claim after body execution
properties.description: After executing all transactions in a block from EDGE-BLOCK-PRODUCER-P2P, the computed state trie root, transaction trie root, receipt trie root, and gas used must exactly match the header claims.
properties.formal_spec: POST: compute_state_root(state) == block.header.state_root AND compute_tx_root(txs) == block.header.transactions_root AND compute_receipt_root(receipts) == block.header.receipt_root AND gas_used == block.header.gas_used
properties.rationale: Root mismatches indicate either incorrect block construction or state transition bugs. All four must match.

properties.title: Paris PoS blocks must have zero difficulty, zero nonce, and empty ommers hash
properties.description: For execution payloads received via EDGE-CL-ENGINE-API, Paris consensus rules require difficulty == 0, nonce == 0x0000000000000000, and ommers_hash == EMPTY_OMMER_HASH.
properties.formal_spec: PRE: block.header.difficulty == 0 AND block.header.nonce == 0 AND block.header.ommers_hash == EMPTY_OMMER_HASH => proceed; ELSE => reject_payload
properties.rationale: Post-Merge blocks must not contain PoW artifacts. Non-zero difficulty or nonce indicates either a PoW block or a malformed payload.

properties.title: Block ommers list must be empty in post-Merge blocks
properties.description: For blocks received via EDGE-CL-ENGINE-API, the ommers field must be an empty list (no uncle blocks in PoS).
properties.formal_spec: PRE: len(block.ommers) == 0 => proceed; ELSE => reject(block)
properties.rationale: Uncle blocks are a PoW concept. Including ommers in PoS blocks would indicate protocol violation.

properties.title: SSZ ProgressiveContainer must have valid active_fields bitmask
properties.description: For SSZ containers received via EDGE-P2P-SSZ-GOSSIP, the ProgressiveContainer active_fields must correctly indicate which fields are present. Inactive fields (bit=0) must not contain data.
properties.formal_spec: PRE: for all i in range(len(container.fields)): if active_fields[i] == 0 then container.fields[i] == default_value(type_i); active_fields length == num_fields
properties.rationale: Incorrect active_fields could cause merkle proof verification to fail or accept invalid proofs.

properties.title: ProgressiveList length must be validated before full deserialization
properties.description: For SSZ data received via EDGE-P2P-SSZ-GOSSIP, ProgressiveList length must be checked against runtime limits BEFORE full decoding to prevent DoS via oversized payloads.
properties.formal_spec: PRE: validate_length(serialized_data) == true => decode(serialized_data); validate_length fails => reject_before_decode
properties.rationale: Without pre-decode length validation, attackers can send arbitrarily large ProgressiveList data to exhaust memory.

properties.title: ProgressiveContainer generalized indices must remain stable across forks
properties.description: For merkle proofs verified at EDGE-OFFCHAIN-PROOF-VERIFY, the generalized index for any field in a ProgressiveContainer must remain constant across fork transitions. Field additions append to the tree without shifting existing indices.
properties.formal_spec: INV: for all field F existing at fork N: generalized_index(F, fork_N) == generalized_index(F, fork_N+1)
properties.rationale: If generalized indices shift across forks, all existing merkle proofs and on-chain verifiers would break.

properties.title: Merkle proof verification must correctly compare computed and expected roots
properties.description: For proof verification at EDGE-OFFCHAIN-PROOF-VERIFY, after computing a merkle root from proof nodes and generalized index, the comparison against the expected state root must be exact equality.
properties.formal_spec: POST: compute_merkle_root(proof_nodes, generalized_index, leaf_value) == expected_root => proof_valid; != => proof_invalid
properties.rationale: Approximate or partial root matching would allow invalid proofs to pass verification.

properties.title: On-chain SSZ proof verification must use stable generalized indices
properties.description: Smart contracts verifying SSZ proofs at EDGE-ONCHAIN-PROOF-VERIFY must receive consistent generalized indices regardless of which fork the proof was generated under.
properties.formal_spec: INV: for all smart_contract_verifier SC, field F: SC.verify(proof, gindex_F) succeeds if and only if proof is valid for field F at any fork where F is active
properties.rationale: On-chain verifiers cannot be easily upgraded. Unstable indices would break deployed verification contracts.

properties.title: Wallet provider SVG icons must be rendered in tags to prevent XSS
properties.description: For wallet providers injected at EDGE-WALLET-INJECT, SVG icon data must be rendered using tags (not inline SVG) to prevent embedded JavaScript execution.
properties.formal_spec: PRE: render_method(provider.info.icon) == IMG_TAG_RENDER => xss_prevented; render_method == INLINE_SVG => xss_possible
properties.rationale: SVG can contain

properties.title: Wallet provider icon must be validated as data:image/svg+xml;base64 format
properties.description: At EDGE-WALLET-INJECT, the icon field must be validated to match the data:image/svg+xml;base64,<data> format before rendering.
properties.formal_spec: PRE: provider.info.icon matches 'data:image/svg+xml;base64,*' => format_valid; ELSE => reject_icon
properties.rationale: Non-SVG data URIs or arbitrary URLs could be used for phishing or content injection attacks.

properties.title: Wallet provider key should follow snake_case naming convention
properties.description: At EDGE-WALLET-INJECT, provider registration keys should match [a-z0-9_]+ pattern to prevent namespace pollution or injection attacks.
properties.formal_spec: PRE: provider_key matches /^[a-z0-9_]+$/ => key_valid; ELSE => warn_non_conforming
properties.rationale: Keys with special characters could interfere with JavaScript property access or be used for prototype pollution.

properties.title: Wallet provider UUID must be valid UUIDv4 format
properties.description: At EDGE-WALLET-INJECT, provider.info.uuid must conform to UUIDv4 format to ensure unique identification.
properties.formal_spec: PRE: provider.info.uuid matches UUIDv4_REGEX => uuid_valid; ELSE => reject_registration
properties.rationale: Invalid UUIDs could cause collisions between providers or break DApp discovery logic.

properties.title: DApp must use user-selected provider without substitution
properties.description: At EDGE-DAPP-USER-INTERACT, after the user selects a wallet provider, the DApp must use the exact provider reference chosen. No automatic redirection to a different provider.
properties.formal_spec: POST: user_selects(provider_X) => dapp.active_provider == provider_X
properties.rationale: Provider substitution would defeat user choice and could redirect funds to attacker-controlled wallets.

properties.title: Hardware wallet signing must produce consistent hashes across container migrations
properties.description: At EDGE-HW-WALLET-SIGN, the ProgressiveContainer serialization format must mirror legacy Container serialization so that hardware wallets signing data produce the same hash before and after migration.
properties.formal_spec: INV: serialize_progressive(container) == serialize_legacy(container) for all containers at migration boundary
properties.rationale: Hardware wallets have limited upgrade capability. Breaking serialization compatibility would make them unable to sign valid data.

properties.title: All blocks from P2P peers must undergo full validation before acceptance
properties.description: For blocks received at EDGE-PEER-P2P-DEVP2P, full validation is required: header validity, transaction list integrity, state root verification, and gas accounting. No shortcuts for blocks from 'trusted' peers.
properties.formal_spec: PRE: for all blocks B from peer P: validate_header(B) AND apply_and_verify_body(B) => accept(B); ELSE => reject(B)
properties.rationale: P2P peers are fully untrusted. Eclipse attacks or malicious peers could send invalid blocks to cause consensus splits.

properties.title: All transactions from P2P peers must be fully validated
properties.description: For transactions received via EDGE-PEER-P2P-DEVP2P, full validation including signature recovery, nonce check, balance sufficiency, and gas checks must be performed.
properties.formal_spec: PRE: for all tx from peer: validate_transaction(tx) == true => accept_to_mempool; ELSE => reject(tx)
properties.rationale: Peer-submitted transactions are untrusted and could be malformed, have invalid signatures, or attempt resource exhaustion.

properties.title: Base fee adjustment must not exceed 12.5% per block
properties.description: The EIP-1559 base fee can change by at most 1/BASE_FEE_MAX_CHANGE_DENOMINATOR (1/8 = 12.5%) per block in either direction.
properties.formal_spec: INV: |new_base_fee - parent_base_fee| <= parent_base_fee / 8 + 1
properties.rationale: Unbounded base fee changes would destabilize the fee market, enabling manipulation attacks.

properties.title: Base fee must never be negative
properties.description: The computed base fee for any block must be >= 0. When gas usage is below target, the decrease must not bring base fee below zero.
properties.formal_spec: INV: for all blocks B: B.header.base_fee_per_gas >= 0
properties.rationale: Negative base fee is undefined and would corrupt fee accounting.

properties.title: Gas refund must not exceed 20% of gas consumed
properties.description: After transaction execution in Paris, the gas refund is capped at gas_used_before_refund / 5 (20%).
properties.formal_spec: POST: refund <= gas_used_before_refund / 5
properties.rationale: Higher refund caps were exploited for gas token arbitrage. The 20% cap limits refund-based DoS attacks.

properties.title: Transaction fee accounting must be conservative: deducted = refunded + burned + miner_tip
properties.description: For each transaction, the initially deducted fee (gas * max_fee) must equal the sum of: refunded gas * effective_price, burned base_fee * gas_used, and priority_fee * gas_used.
properties.formal_spec: POST: initial_deduction == sender_refund + base_fee_burned + priority_fee_to_coinbase
properties.rationale: Fee conservation ensures no value is created or destroyed during transaction processing.

properties.title: Block gas limit change must be within 1/1024 of parent
properties.description: For any block, the gas limit must satisfy |gas_limit - parent_gas_limit| < parent_gas_limit / GAS_LIMIT_ADJUSTMENT_FACTOR (1024).
properties.formal_spec: PRE: abs(block.gas_limit - parent.gas_limit) < parent.gas_limit / 1024 => valid; ELSE => reject
properties.rationale: Unbounded gas limit changes could be used to destabilize block processing capacity.

properties.title: Beacon roots and history storage system transactions must execute before user transactions
properties.description: System transactions (beacon roots at 0x000F3df6D732807Ef1319fB7B8bB8522d0Beac02, history storage at 0x0000F90827F1C53a10cb7A02335B175320002935) must execute before any user transaction in the block.
properties.formal_spec: POST: execution_order(system_tx_beacon_roots) < execution_order(system_tx_history_storage) < execution_order(user_tx_0)
properties.rationale: System transactions set up block context (beacon root, parent hash) that user transactions may depend on.

properties.title: System transaction target contracts must have deployed code
properties.description: Before executing system transactions, the target contract addresses must have deployed code. Missing code causes InvalidBlock.
properties.formal_spec: PRE: get_code(BEACON_ROOTS_ADDRESS) != empty AND get_code(HISTORY_STORAGE_ADDRESS) != empty => execute_system_tx; ELSE => InvalidBlock
properties.rationale: System transactions to empty addresses would silently succeed without storing required data, breaking beacon root and history lookups.

properties.title: Requests must be ordered by type: deposits, withdrawals, consolidations
properties.description: After processing all transactions, requests must be collected in ascending request type order: deposit requests from logs, then withdrawal requests from predeploy, then consolidation requests from predeploy.
properties.formal_spec: POST: for all i < j in requests: requests[i].type <= requests[j].type
properties.rationale: Incorrect request ordering would cause consensus disagreement between nodes processing the same block.

properties.title: Withdrawal amounts must be converted from Gwei to Wei correctly
properties.description: When processing beacon chain withdrawals, the amount (in Gwei) must be multiplied by 10^9 before crediting to the withdrawal address.
properties.formal_spec: POST: for all withdrawal W: balance_increase(W.address) == W.amount * 10^9
properties.rationale: Incorrect unit conversion would either credit too little (9 orders of magnitude less) or too much, creating or destroying value.

properties.title: Post-refund gas used must be at least the EIP-7623 calldata floor
properties.description: After gas refund calculation, the effective gas used must be max(gas_after_refund, calldata_floor_cost). This ensures calldata-heavy transactions pay a minimum gas cost.
properties.formal_spec: POST: effective_gas_used >= calldata_floor_cost AND effective_gas_used >= gas_used_after_refund
properties.rationale: EIP-7623 prevents underpriced calldata by imposing a floor on gas consumption based on calldata size.

properties.title: EVM memory must be zero-initialized and expanded with zero bytes
properties.description: EVM memory is always initialized to all zeros. Any memory expansion fills new bytes with 0x00.
properties.formal_spec: INV: for all memory M at initialization: M[i] == 0 for all i; for expansion from size S to S': M[S..S'] == 0
properties.rationale: Non-zero initialization could leak data between execution contexts or cause nondeterministic behavior.

properties.title: Memory expansion gas cost must be charged before memory access
properties.description: Gas for memory expansion must be deducted before the actual memory read/write occurs. Out-of-gas must prevent the operation.
properties.formal_spec: POST: charge_gas(expansion_cost + base_cost) succeeds => memory_op_executes; charge_gas fails => out_of_gas, no memory modification
properties.rationale: Charging gas after memory access would allow unbounded memory allocation before payment.

properties.title: MCOPY must handle overlapping source and destination ranges correctly
properties.description: When MCOPY source and destination ranges overlap, the operation must behave like memmove (reads all source bytes before writing), not memcpy.
properties.formal_spec: POST: after mcopy(dst, src, len): memory[dst..dst+len] == old_memory[src..src+len] (captured before write)
properties.rationale: Incorrect overlap handling would corrupt data during copy operations within overlapping ranges.

properties.title: CREATE2 address computation must be deterministic
properties.description: CREATE2 address = keccak256(0xff ++ sender ++ salt ++ keccak256(init_code))[12:]. Same inputs must always produce the same address.
properties.formal_spec: INV: CREATE2_address(sender, salt, init_code) is a pure function of (sender, salt, init_code)
properties.rationale: Non-deterministic address computation would break counterfactual instantiation patterns used in many DeFi protocols.

properties.title: CREATE must validate balance sufficiency, nonce limits, and stack depth
properties.description: Before executing CREATE/CREATE2, the system must verify: sender.balance >= endowment, sender.nonce < 2^64-1, and call_stack_depth < 1024.
properties.formal_spec: PRE: sender.balance >= endowment AND sender.nonce < 2^64-1 AND stack_depth < 1024 => proceed; ELSE => push(0) to stack
properties.rationale: Missing precondition checks could lead to balance underflow, nonce overflow, or stack overflow attacks.

properties.title: Call stack depth must never exceed 1024
properties.description: The EVM call stack depth is limited to 1024. Any CALL/CREATE that would exceed this limit must fail gracefully by pushing 0 to the stack.
properties.formal_spec: INV: stack_depth <= 1024; at stack_depth == 1024: CALL/CREATE push 0 without executing child
properties.rationale: Without depth limits, recursive calls could exhaust host machine stack space or memory.

properties.title: Child call must receive at most 63/64 of remaining gas
properties.description: When a CALL variant forwards gas to a child execution, the forwarded gas must not exceed floor(remaining_gas * 63/64).
properties.formal_spec: POST: child_gas <= floor(remaining_gas * 63 / 64)
properties.rationale: The 63/64 rule ensures the caller retains enough gas to handle child call results, preventing call-depth gas attacks.

properties.title: STATICCALL must not modify state
properties.description: During a STATICCALL execution, no state modifications (storage writes, balance transfers, contract creation, selfdestruct, log emission) may occur.
properties.formal_spec: INV: in STATICCALL context: state_write_ops == 0 AND log_ops == 0 AND create_ops == 0 AND selfdestruct_ops == 0
properties.rationale: STATICCALL is used for view functions. State modifications would violate the caller's expectations and enable reentrancy.

properties.title: SELFDESTRUCT only deletes contracts created in the same transaction (EIP-6780)
properties.description: Post-EIP-6780, SELFDESTRUCT only marks an account for deletion if it was created in the same transaction. Pre-existing contracts only have their balance transferred.
properties.formal_spec: POST: if contract in created_accounts_this_tx: mark_for_deletion(contract) AND transfer_balance; ELSE: transfer_balance_only, no deletion
properties.rationale: Legacy SELFDESTRUCT behavior could be exploited for storage cleanup incentive gaming. EIP-6780 limits the blast radius.

properties.title: SELFDESTRUCT must halt execution of current context
properties.description: After SELFDESTRUCT executes (balance transfer and optional deletion marking), execution of the current context must stop immediately.
properties.formal_spec: POST: after selfdestruct: evm.running == false
properties.rationale: Continuing execution after SELFDESTRUCT could access invalid state or execute unintended code.

properties.title: RETURN must correctly capture output data from memory
properties.description: When RETURN executes, the output data must be exactly the bytes from memory[offset:offset+size] as specified by the popped stack values.
properties.formal_spec: POST: evm.output == memory[offset:offset+size]
properties.rationale: Incorrect output capture would return wrong data to the caller, breaking contract interactions.

properties.title: REVERT must roll back all state changes but preserve output data
properties.description: When REVERT executes, all state changes in the current execution context must be rolled back, but the output data (revert reason) must be available to the caller.
properties.formal_spec: POST: state == state_before_call AND evm.output == memory[offset:offset+size] AND evm.error == Revert
properties.rationale: REVERT without rollback would leave partial state changes. REVERT without output would lose the revert reason.

properties.title: Return data buffer must be isolated per call frame
properties.description: Each EVM call frame has its own return data buffer. The buffer cannot be accessed or modified by other call frames.
properties.formal_spec: INV: for all call frames F1, F2 where F1 != F2: F1.returndata_buffer is independent of F2.returndata_buffer
properties.rationale: Cross-frame return data access could leak sensitive information between unrelated contract calls.

properties.title: Return data buffer must be cleared before each call-like opcode
properties.description: Before executing any call-like opcode (CALL, DELEGATECALL, CALLCODE, STATICCALL, CREATE, CREATE2), the return data buffer must be cleared to prevent stale data leakage.
properties.formal_spec: POST: before_call_execution: returndata_buffer.size == 0
properties.rationale: Stale return data from a previous call could be incorrectly interpreted if the buffer is not cleared.

properties.title: RETURNDATACOPY must reject out-of-bounds access
properties.description: RETURNDATACOPY(destOffset, offset, length) must verify offset + length <= RETURNDATASIZE without overflow. Violation triggers out-of-gas exception.
properties.formal_spec: PRE: offset + length <= returndatasize AND no_overflow(offset + length) => copy_proceeds; ELSE => out_of_gas_exception
properties.rationale: Out-of-bounds return data access could read uninitialized memory or cause buffer overflows.

properties.title: SLOAD must charge 800 gas post-Istanbul
properties.description: After Istanbul fork, SLOAD gas cost is 800 (increased from 200). Insufficient gas must cause out-of-gas.
properties.formal_spec: POST: sload_gas_cost == 800; available_gas < 800 => out_of_gas
properties.rationale: EIP-1884 increased SLOAD cost to better reflect trie-access costs. Contracts assuming 200 gas may fail.

properties.title: BALANCE must charge 700 gas post-Istanbul
properties.description: After Istanbul fork, BALANCE gas cost is 700 (increased from 400).
properties.formal_spec: POST: balance_gas_cost == 700; available_gas < 700 => out_of_gas
properties.rationale: EIP-1884 repricing to reflect actual trie-access resource consumption.

properties.title: SELFBALANCE must return current contract balance at cost of 5 gas
properties.description: The SELFBALANCE opcode (0x47) pushes the balance of the currently executing contract to the stack, costing only 5 gas.
properties.formal_spec: POST: stack_top == get_balance(current_address) AND gas_consumed == 5
properties.rationale: SELFBALANCE provides a cheap alternative to BALANCE for checking own balance, avoiding the 700 gas BALANCE cost.

properties.title: CHAINID opcode must return the canonical chain ID for the network
properties.description: The CHAINID opcode (0x46) must always return the correct EIP-155 chain ID for the network. This value must be consistent across all blocks.
properties.formal_spec: INV: CHAINID() == canonical_chain_id for all execution contexts on the same network
properties.rationale: Incorrect chain ID would defeat replay protection, allowing transaction replay across chains.

properties.title: BLAKE2b precompile must validate input is exactly 213 bytes
properties.description: The BLAKE2b F function precompile at address 0x09 must reject any input that is not exactly 213 bytes.
properties.formal_spec: PRE: len(input) == 213 => execute_blake2b; len(input) != 213 => precompile_failure
properties.rationale: Incorrect input length would cause incorrect parsing of the rounds, h, m, t, and f parameters.

properties.title: EMPTY_ACCOUNT constant must be used consistently for non-existent accounts
properties.description: The EMPTY_ACCOUNT (nonce=0, balance=0, code=empty) must be the canonical representation for all non-existent accounts across all code paths.
properties.formal_spec: INV: for all addresses A where account_exists(A) == false: get_account(A) == EMPTY_ACCOUNT
properties.rationale: Inconsistent empty account representation could cause state trie inconsistencies or incorrect balance checks.

properties.title: Account RLP encoding must be deterministic
properties.description: For the same account state (nonce, balance, storage_root, code_hash), the RLP encoding must always produce identical bytes.
properties.formal_spec: INV: encode_account(A, storage_root) is a pure function of (A.nonce, A.balance, storage_root, keccak256(A.code))
properties.rationale: Non-deterministic encoding would break state trie root computation, causing consensus failures.

properties.title: Cold account access must charge 2600 gas, warm access 100 gas
properties.description: For CALL variants, first access to an address costs GAS_COLD_ACCOUNT_ACCESS (2600 gas). Subsequent accesses within the same transaction cost GAS_WARM_ACCESS (100 gas).
properties.formal_spec: POST: first_access(address) => charge(2600) AND mark_warm(address); subsequent_access(address) => charge(100)
properties.rationale: Correct warm/cold pricing prevents DoS through repeated cold accesses at warm prices.

properties.title: Transaction sender must be an EOA (not a contract)
properties.description: For transactions validated at the Paris or Prague fork level, the sender address must not have contract code deployed (or must have valid delegation code per EIP-7702).
properties.formal_spec: PRE: get_code(sender) == empty OR is_valid_delegation(get_code(sender)) => proceed; ELSE => reject(tx)
properties.rationale: Contract-initiated transactions outside of EIP-7702 delegation would bypass intended access controls.

properties.title: Blocks from MEV relays must undergo full EL validation
properties.description: Block bids received at EDGE-MEV-RELAY-BUILDER must pass full execution layer validation including header checks, state transition, and root verification before acceptance.
properties.formal_spec: PRE: for all blocks B from MEV relay: validate_block(B) == full_el_validation(B); no validation shortcuts
properties.rationale: MEV relays are untrusted external services. Accepting unvalidated blocks could lead to invalid state transitions.
